about.title: About
about.heading: About Packvio
about.lead: Packvio is the packaging brand of Smavio Limited Trading Co., supplying food and beverage packaging by the case to businesses across Saudi Arabia.
about.body1: We work with cafés, restaurants, bakeries, cloud kitchens and catering companies — the businesses that get through thousands of cups and boxes a month and cannot afford a supplier who runs out. Our range covers the whole service journey: the cup a drink is served in, the lid that keeps it there, the box a meal travels in and the bag it is handed over in.
about.body2: Everything is sold by the case, in quantities from 200 to 6,000 units, and most of the range can carry your logo. We hold stock in Riyadh, and we quote from a product code and a quantity — no account to open, no minimum spend to qualify for an answer.

vision.heading: What we're building
vision.body: A packaging supplier that a food business can plan around: consistent stock, honest lead times, and a quote back quickly enough to be useful.
vision.body2: Saudi Arabia's food and beverage sector is growing fast, and the businesses in it are increasingly judged on presentation as much as on what they serve. We want the packaging part of that to be the easy part — dependable supply, food-contact grade materials, and branding that looks like it was planned rather than improvised.

serves.heading: Who we supply
serves.intro: From a single café to a catering operation running several sites.

company.body: Packvio is a trading name of Smavio Limited Trading Co., registered in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Orders, invoicing and VAT are handled under that entity, and our online store is operated on Salla.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Ordering, printing, delivery and materials. If your question is not here, ask us — we answer quickly.
faq.whatsappPrefill: Hello Packvio — I have a question about:

aside.heading: Still not sure?
aside.body: Send us the product codes and quantities and we will come back with pricing, lead time and printing options.

howToOrder.q: How do I place an order?
howToOrder.a: Send us a quote request with the items and quantities you need — from the quote form, from any product page, or on WhatsApp. We reply with pricing, lead time and printing options. Some lines can also be bought directly through our online store, and those show an "Order on our store" button on the product page.

caseOnly.q: Do you sell single units, or only by the case?
caseOnly.a: By the case. Packvio is a wholesale supplier, and every line is priced and shipped in case quantities — from 200 units up to 6,000 depending on the item. The exact case size is shown on each product page under "Units per case".

notListed.q: Can I order something that isn't on the site?
notListed.a: Yes. The quote form has a free-text line for items we do not list — describe what you need and we will tell you whether we can source it. The catalog here is what we stock regularly, not the limit of what we can supply.

referenceNumber.q: What is the reference number on my quote request?
referenceNumber.a: Every request gets a reference in the form PV-2026-0001, shown on screen as soon as you submit. Quote it when you contact us about that request — it is how our sales team finds it immediately.

canYouPrint.q: Can you print my logo on the packaging?
canYouPrint.a: Yes, on selected products. We print in one to four colours, matched to your brand palette. Paper cups, sleeves, kraft boxes, lunch boxes, carry bags and wrapping paper all take print; lids, cutlery and equipment do not.

artworkFormat.q: What artwork do you need from me?
artworkFormat.a: Vector artwork prints best — AI, EPS, PDF or SVG. Send us what you have and we will check it and tell you if anything needs adjusting before it goes on press. We will also advise on how your colours will actually come out on the material you have chosen, since kraft, white board and PE-lined stock all take ink differently.

proof.q: Will I see a proof before you print?
proof.a: Always. We send a digital proof showing your logo positioned on the product, and nothing goes on press until you have approved it.

whichProducts.a: Cups, sleeves, kraft boxes, lunch boxes, carry bags and wrapping paper. Lids, cutlery and sealing equipment are not printed. You can see the full printable range by filtering the products listing on "Custom printing available".

foodSafe.q: Are your products safe for direct contact with food?
foodSafe.a: Yes. We supply food-contact grade paper and board, with PE and PET linings where the product needs a moisture or grease barrier, selected for direct contact with food and drink. If you need the supplier documentation for a specific line for your own records, ask us and we will send what we hold.

petVsPp.q: What is the difference between PET and PP cups?
petVsPp.a: PET is the glass-clear, rigid plastic used for cold drinks — it looks the best and holds its shape, but it softens with heat. PP is slightly less clear and a little more flexible, and tolerates warmer contents. For iced coffee and juice, PET; for anything that may go in warm, PP.

lidsFit.q: Do your lids fit your cups?
lidsFit.a: Yes — lids are listed by the cup diameter they fit, and the diameter is shown in the specifications on both the cup and the lid. Coffee cups, soup cups and clear cups each have their own lid category. If you are unsure which lid goes with which cup, send us the cup code and we will confirm.
